'''Trooper1124 EJP Hunt Down''' is a [[Dark]] deck by Trooper1124 and [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds99.htm EJP Hunt Down], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228055508/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds99.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' Trooper1124 and [[Rod Latham]]

* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
